items.name: Thessaly's Storm Grips
items.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a BRAND-NEW transparent fantasy RPG inventory sprite depicting a PAIR of legendary wearable gauntlets. Thessaly: two deep cobalt and silver storm gauntlets with a wing-shaped cuff silhouette, polished gold trim, one large luminous sapphire set on each backhand, strong silver knuckle guards, a few delicate semi-transparent cyan lightning ribbons. Elegant and regal, visually distinct from the Ashmaw dragon armor. Hand-painted semi-realistic fantasy item art with crisp dark outlines, dimensional shading and brilliant edge highlights, matching ornate raid-unique equipment in the game. Composition: two separate gauntlets in matching three-quarter view, cuffs toward upper-left/upper-right, armored backs toward viewer, fingers pointing diagonally down and slightly inward. The gauntlets should look wearable over NORMAL HUMAN HANDS, informed by the anatomy of the input reference images. On EACH hand show exactly FIVE digits: FOUR separate fingers across a gently arched knuckle line plus ONE distinct side thumb attached LOWER than the fingers. Proportions: middle longest, index and ring a little shorter, pinky clearly shorter; each finger bends naturally at two joints and tapers toward a blunt armored tip. A thumb emerges from the side of the palm near the wrist, angled across; narrow wrist beneath decorated cuff. Show all TEN fingertips visibly separated; four finger tips and one thumb tip per hand. Keep both hands in frame with clear margins. Legendary grandeur from silhouette, focal gem, skilled metalwork and restrained translucent effects; leave hand anatomy clear. True transparent background, no text, labels, border, people, skin or extra hands. Input image 1: approved paired gauntlet pose/composition reference ONLY; reinvent armor completely. Input image 2: anatomy reference for four fingers and thumb. Input image 3: anatomy reference for flexible armored hand joints.
Anatomy correction: Use case: precise-object-edit. Anatomy correction of the storm-gauntlet pair. Both gauntlets in this image have THREE long fingers plus a side thumb. Add a NEW FOURTH long finger to EACH hand. On the left-hand gauntlet insert a separate armored RING FINGER between its central finger and the existing rightmost long finger. On the right-hand gauntlet insert a separate armored RING FINGER between its central finger and the existing rightmost long finger. Expand the width of each palm and knuckle arc slightly to fit the extra finger. Do not replace or split an existing finger: ADD exactly one new finger to each hand, with its own knuckle, two joints and blunt silver fingertip. Preserve the existing three long fingers and the existing angled side thumb on each. Result EACH hand: exactly FOUR distinct long fingers PLUS ONE side thumb, five tips, ten tips total. Preserve three-quarter pose, blue/silver/gold winged storm cuff, sapphire gem, hand-painted style, delicate translucent lightning and transparent background. Give generous margins and no text.
